description.value: Whole Foods Market Cambie is a large natural and organic supermarket situated in Vancouver's South Cambie neighbourhood, part of a 500+ store global chain known for strict quality and sustainability standards. Beyond groceries, the store hosts a cluster of in-house eateries including a coffee bar, pizza counter, burrito bar, sandwich station, and cold-pressed juice bar. For a touring cyclist, it offers one of the more comprehensive resupply options in the city, with organic and specialty food alongside ready-made hot meals.

Total: 46 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content for the Cambie branch confirms address (510 W 8th Ave Vancouver, BC V5Z 1C5) and phone ((778) 370-4210), matching OSM exactly. The store page lists 'Hot & Salad Bar' under Store Amenities and multiple in-store eateries (Burrito Bar, Pizza, Coffee Bar, Juice Truck), confirming hot food. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific infrastructure appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A large, well-stocked natural and organic supermarket with hot food options is a strong resupply point for touring cyclists; OSM record is current (check_date 2024-10-03) and all contact details are verified.
